                 head_color=INK, mark=True):

    tf = tb(slide, l, t, w, 0.4)
    for i, item in enumerate(items):

        style(p, space_before=0 if i == 0 else gap, line=1.35)

        pPr.set("marL", "171450")

        if mark:
            run(p, "▪  ", size, True, BLUE)
        for txt, bold, *rest in item:
            run(p, txt, size, bold, rest[0] if rest else (head_color if bold else color))
    return tf

def draw_table(slide, x, y, col_fracs, header_row, data, row_h=0.42,
               head_h=0.34, size=12, aligns=None, bold_last=False,
               cell_colors=None):
    """Hand-drawn table: header rule + hairline rows."""
    total = sum(col_fracs)
    xs, acc = [], x
    for f in col_fracs:
        xs.append(acc)
        acc += f / total * CW
    aligns = aligns or [PP_ALIGN.LEFT] + [PP_ALIGN.CENTER] * (len(col_fracs) - 1)

    for j, htxt in enumerate(header_row):
        tf = tb(slide, xs[j], y, (col_fracs[j] / total * CW) - 0.1, head_h)
        p = style(tf.paragraphs[0], align=aligns[j])
        run(p, htxt, 9.5, False, MUTED)
    line(slide, x, y + head_h, CW, RGBColor(0xC9, 0xD2, 0xE0), 1.0)

    for i, rowv in enumerate(data):
        ry = y + head_h + 0.06 + i * row_h
        last = (i == len(data) - 1)
        for j, cell in enumerate(rowv):
            tf = tb(slide, xs[j], ry, (col_fracs[j] / total * CW) - 0.1, row_h,
                    anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE)
            p = style(tf.paragraphs[0], align=aligns[j])
            bold = bold_last and last
            col = INK if j == 0 else INK
            if cell_colors and (i, j) in cell_colors:
                col = cell_colors[(i, j)]
            run(p, cell, size, bold or (bold_last and last), col)
        if not last:
            line(slide, x, ry + row_h, CW, HAIR, 0.75)
    return y + head_h + 0.06 + len(data) * row_h

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open("data/q3-metrics.csv")))

def nostyle(sh):
    """Remove theme <p:style> so no inherited shadow / line / fill."""
    sp = sh._element
    st = sp.find(qn("p:style"))

def rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill, shape=MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE):
    sh = nostyle(slide.shapes.add_shape(shape, In(x), In(y), In(w), In(h)))

    sh.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill
    sh.line.fill.background()
    sh.shadow.inherit = False
    return sh


def line(slide, x, y, w, color=RULE, width=1.0):
    sh = nostyle(slide.shapes.add_connector(1, In(x), In(y), In(x + w), In(y)))
    sh.line.color.rgb = color
    sh.line.width = Pt(width)

class T:
    """Tiny text helper: T(slide, x, y, w, h).p([(text, bold, color)], size=...)"""

    def __init__(self, slide, x, y, w, h, anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP, wrap=True):
        self.box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(In(x), In(y), In(w), In(h))
        self.tf = self.box.text_frame
        self.tf.word_wrap = wrap
        self.tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
        self.tf.margin_left = self.tf.margin_right = 0
        self.tf.margin_top = self.tf.margin_bottom = 0
        self.n = 0

    def p(self, runs, size=12, color=BODY, line_sp=1.3, before=0, after=0,
          align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, hang=False, bold=False):
        if isinstance(runs, str):
            runs = [(runs, bold, color)]
        para = self.tf.paragraphs[0] if self.n == 0 else self.tf.add_paragraph()
        self.n += 1
        para.alignment = align
        para.space_before = Pt(before)
        para.space_after = Pt(after)
        para.line_spacing = line_sp
        if hang:
            pPr = para._p.get_or_add_pPr()
            pPr.set("marL", "171450")
            pPr.set("indent", "-171450")
        for item in runs:
            text = item[0]
            b = item[1] if len(item) > 1 else bold
            c = item[2] if len(item) > 2 else (INK if b else color)
            self._run(para, text, size, b, c)
        return para

    @staticmethod
    def _run(para, text, size, bold, color):
        r = para.add_run()
        r.text = text
        f = r.font
        f.name, f.size, f.bold = FONT, Pt(size), bold
        f.color.rgb = color
        rPr = r._r.get_or_add_rPr()
        ea = rPr.find(qn("a:ea"))
        if ea is None:
            ea = rPr.makeelement(qn("a:ea"), {})
            rPr.append(ea)
        ea.set("typeface", FONT)

    total = sum(fracs)
